trust_decision.summary: Which signed Biscuit facts (user, domain, client_ip) and which authorizer facts (resource, operation) hold is decided by Datalog source built by f-string interpolation of untrusted values (Host header, request path, username), so a quote in those values can add facts such as role(...) and change the read/write authorization decision; secondary: instance hostname accepted by a permissive blocklist regex.

landing_point.why: The CWE-74 injection summary plus 'Biscuit' leads straight to BiscuitTokenFactory.create_token_for_role, where domain("{request.host}") is interpolated into the signed token source.

fix_sites.entry_point: POST /login (src/ui/app/routes/login.py:62) and token regeneration on any authenticated request (src/ui/app/models/biscuit.py:129)
every authenticated UI request via BiscuitMiddleware before_request (resource_path falls back to request.path at src/ui/app/models/biscuit.py:176)
every UI request (new Host allowlist added in before_request)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/api/app/routers/auth.py:120-126 (API service token builder, untouched by fix) and src/api/app/auth/biscuit.py:484-489 (API authorizer facts from request path)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory and fix are all under src/ui; the FastAPI service in src/api is a separate, often internal-only component, and its auth.py already has an _esc() helper (src/api/app/routers/auth.py:138-139) so it looks already escaped at a glance, though _esc is applied only to api_perm and not to user/domain.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate Host values with a port (host:5000), IPv6 literals and underscore container names must still log in and produce a domain fact. Path-prefix policies (starts_with("/profile"), == "/set_theme") and read-only POST endpoints must keep working. Rejecting or over-escaping the Host or path, or dropping the request.path fallback, would break login behind proxies or lock users out of /profile.

O6_input_shapes: time as typed datetime (moved to a parameter)
instance hostname (IPv4, IPv6, DNS label, trailing dot)

O7_producer.where: Token facts are produced inline in the factory/handler (src/ui/app/models/biscuit.py:288; src/api/app/routers/auth.py:120). Signed facts cross a serialization boundary (token.to_base64 stored in session, src/ui/app/routes/login.py:62) and are consumed later by the authorizer, but the producer is the same function the fix edits.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: API POST /auth builds the signed token with domain("{host}") from the Host header and user("{username}") by f-string, the same injection into the same Biscuit token sink
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: separate API service not mentioned in the UI advisory; an _esc helper in the same function suggests escaping is already handled
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: src/api vs src/ui: different package and framework (FastAPI vs Flask)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: API BiscuitGuard adds authorizer facts resource("{path}") and resource_id("{rid}") from the request path by f-string, so a crafted path can add authorizer facts such as admin(true) that the policies trust
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: path is routed by FastAPI and looks pre-validated; the fine-grained mapping only fires for known resource types
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: src/api/app/auth, different package from landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: API BiscuitGuard client_ip check is interpolated by f-string (same pattern the UI fix parameterized)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: client IP comes from the socket and is not attacker-shaped

O8_uncovered_routes.route: API POST /instances validates hostname with the same permissive blocklist regex that the UI fix replaced with is_valid_host
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: API callers are already authenticated admins/automation; the UI form was the reported surface

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a role-name or plugin-permission fact built by f-string from a DB-stored role or permission name
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Roles are already passed as strings and the PRO roles feature makes dynamic role names a natural extension.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: fine-grained api_perm facts whose escaping misses a control character or backslash-ordering case
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A hand-rolled _esc already exists; a maintainer could easily ship a near-miss escaper instead of parameter binding.

O9_family: injection (Datalog/Biscuit policy-language injection via string-built facts) plus input validation of hostnames

O10_build.toolchain: Python 3 with pip; biscuit-python is pinned to a GitHub source zip (src/ui/requirements.txt:76, src/api/requirements.txt:86), so it likely needs a Rust/maturin build or a prebuilt wheel
services: database (SQLite is possible) for full app
none needed for unit-level BiscuitTokenFactory/BiscuitGuard tests
O10_build.project_tests: No Python tests for biscuit or _sanitize_internal_next under tests/; the fix diff adds no tests

out_of_scope_notes: The fix bundles unrelated hardening (session fixation, open redirect in next, cache authz bypass, revoked-session pruning); these are separate protections, not this advisory's Datalog/validation property.
